Bups Are Alive design system

Colours, type, spacing and radii, defined in design/tokens.json.

Engine
Godot 4.7
Colour scheme
Dark
Units
px, scaled
Input
Keyboard and mouse/trackpad

Principles

  1. Neutral first: dark panels, hairline border, mostly one fill. Colour carries meaning.
  2. One accent: teal-green marks selection and the main action.
  3. Two typefaces: IBM Plex Sans for text, Commit Mono for every number.
  4. Containers first: containers lay out screens. Only the banner, dialog titles, hover card and tutorial card are placed by position.
  5. Interface only: bup, gene and dish colours are artwork, not tokens.

Interface size

  • Setting: 60% to 250%. Text scales fully.
  • Text: IBM Plex Sans is the baseline; Commit Mono is drawn at 77% of it.
  • Room: paddings, gaps and control heights grow at power 0.35.

Naming and use

Tokens are named by role, such as text and popup_border, never by appearance.

Tokens reach the game through the generated theme (scenes/menu_theme.tres). Nodes use a theme_type_variation; none override a colour, size or font.

Floating surfaces

  • Dialog: surface_solid. Centred over a scrim, no close cross. Title and text share a left edge. OK is the main button; in a destructive dialog, Cancel is.
  • Hover card: surface. Beside the pointer; flips at a screen edge.
  • Tooltip: tooltip_fill. Beside the pointer. Names and icons only.

Accessibility

Checked against the Xbox Accessibility Guidelines: 101, text display; 102, contrast.

Text size

Minimum body height (ascender to descender) is 18 px on a 1080p PC screen, and text must scale to 200%. Failures are below the minimum at 100%.

SizeDesignText drawn at 100%Numbers drawn at 100%Use
xs12 px15 px11 pxGenome map symbols, graph ticks
s13 px16 px12 pxHints, notes, units, badges, popup menus, section headings

3xl22 px27 px21 pxHeadings

Contrast

Text needs 4.5:1; large text, inactive text and non-text marks need 3:1. Failures are outlined. Translucent fills are omitted: their ground is the dish.
